design.intent: 以短非谐波余韵标记立体表面/图形面的切换，不把每次切换都做低频撞击。
design.use_when: 有明确结构或表面变化的动作节点；可以是抽象配合，不声称真实金属碰撞。
design.avoid_when: 成功提示、和声收束、角色动作未发生、连续快速镜头或需要实录材质。
design.mix_notes: 固定 recipe：420/913/1647Hz；相对幅度0.8/0.35/0.15；衰减12/16/24每秒；总幅度0.3；3ms端点保护；无随机数，seed不适用。须试听余韵是否遮蔽旋律。

source.creator: MotionStudio contributors
source.provenance: Original bounded procedural synthesis; no recordings, samples, borrowed melody or brand audio. Parameters and deterministic seed are stated in mix_notes. This standard-library recipe is a portable derivation, not a byte-identical copy of an earlier numerical-library draft.

rights.conditions: Retain the MIT copyright and permission notice with the source and generated asset redistribution. No trademark, voice or endorsement rights implied.
rights.basis: Original source and synthesis without third-party samples.

review.limits: NOT_LISTENED: no timbre, pleasantness, material realism, mix suitability, seam or owner approval. Render receipts and Audio Core checks only establish technical execution. Do not classify it as accepted because an authored cue consumed it.
